scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix cadence install && npm --prefix dev/mock-ha install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n mock,server,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm --prefix dev/mock-ha start" "npm --prefix cadence run dev:server" "npm --prefix cadence run dev:web"
